actions_add_own_key_first.message: Add one of your own keys first
actions_add_own_key_first.description: Disabled reason of toggles that need one of the user's own keys when they own none.

actions_add_recipients_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the recipient picker's inline search input while no recipient is selected.

actions_age_cannot_sign.description: Disabled reason of the sign toggle while SSH (age) recipients are selected. 'age' is the tool name, lower-case.

actions_badge_you.description: Tiny badge on a recipient option that is one of the user's own keys. Must fit in a small pill: 1 short word.

actions_clear_all_recipients.description: aria-label and tooltip of the x button that removes every selected recipient.

actions_clear_input.description: Command palette: clear the workspace input and output.

actions_copy_output.description: Command palette: copy the operation result to the clipboard.

actions_disabled_toast.description: Toast shown when a keyboard shortcut fires for a command that cannot run right now. $name$ is the command name, $reason$ the short explanation.

actions_download_output.description: Command palette: download the operation result.

actions_encrypt_to_self_off.message: Turn off: Also encrypt to me
actions_encrypt_to_self_off.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Also encrypt to me' preference is on; running it turns the preference off.

actions_encrypt_to_self_on.message: Turn on: Also encrypt to me
actions_encrypt_to_self_on.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Also encrypt to me' preference is off; running it turns the preference on. 'Also encrypt to me' must match the workspace checkbox label.

actions_find_replace.description: Command palette: open the message box's find and replace bar.

actions_generate_key.description: Command palette: open the key generation page.

actions_go_to_keys.description: Command palette navigation to the Keys tab. 'Keys' is the tab name.

actions_go_to_settings.description: Command palette navigation to the Settings tab. 'Settings' is the tab name.

actions_go_to_workspace.description: Command palette navigation to the Workspace tab. 'Workspace' is the tab name.

actions_group_contacts.description: Key selector / recipient dropdown group heading: other people's public keys.

actions_group_keys.description: Command palette group heading: key management commands. Must match the Keys tab name.

actions_group_message.description: Command palette group heading: message text editing commands.

actions_group_mode.description: Command palette group heading: commands that switch the workspace mode.

actions_group_my_keys.description: Key selector / recipient dropdown group heading: the user's own keys. Must match the Keys tab heading of the same name.

actions_group_navigation.description: Command palette group heading: 'Go to ...' commands.

actions_group_recent.description: Recipient dropdown group heading: recently used recipients.

actions_group_result.description: Command palette group heading: commands acting on the decrypted/verified result.

actions_group_session.description: Command palette group heading: session commands (lock).

actions_group_settings.description: Command palette group heading: settings commands. Must match the Settings tab name.

actions_group_workspace.description: Command palette group heading: workspace commands. Must match the Workspace tab name.

actions_history.description: History page title, and the tooltip / aria-label of the small clock icon button in the workspace that opens it.

actions_history_clear.description: Trash icon tooltip / aria-label in the history page header, and the title and confirm button of the confirmation page.

actions_history_delete_all_one.description: Bold headline of the clear-history confirmation page.

actions_history_delete_all_other.description: Bold headline of the clear-history confirmation page.

actions_history_delete_warning.message: This permanently deletes your encrypted operation history from this device. It can't be recovered.
actions_history_delete_warning.description: Body text of the clear-history confirmation page.

actions_history_empty.description: Empty state of the history page when history is on but nothing has been recorded yet.

actions_history_file_with_size.description: One file in the history entry detail: filename and its formatted size, e.g. 'report.pdf (1.2 MB)'.

actions_history_files_one.description: History row title when the operation ran on files (the single-file case usually shows the filename instead).

actions_history_files_other.description: History row title when the operation ran on several files.

actions_history_metadata_only.message: Metadata only - content is not stored for this operation.
actions_history_metadata_only.description: History entry detail page, shown instead of content for decrypt/verify entries, whose plaintext is never saved.

actions_history_more_matches_one.description: Suffix after a history search snippet when the query occurs again further in the content. Keep the leading plus sign.

actions_history_more_matches_other.description: Suffix after a history search snippet when the query occurs again further in the content. Keep the leading plus sign.

actions_history_no_content.description: History row title (italic) for an entry that stored no content and no files, e.g. a decrypt.

actions_history_no_matches.description: History page, when a search query matches no entry. $query$ is the user's typed search text.

actions_history_off_never_cache.message: History is off while keys never cache
actions_history_off_never_cache.description: Disabled reason of history commands when the 'Never auto-cache keys' setting is on, which makes history unavailable.

actions_history_off_reason.message: History is off - enable it next to Sign
actions_history_off_reason.description: Shown when history is disabled: the history page empty state, and the disabled reason of the 'Open history' command in the command palette. 'Sign' refers to the 'Sign when encrypting' checkbox in the workspace, next to which the history checkbox sits.

actions_history_op_signed.description: Operation label for an encrypt that was also signed. $op$ is the operation name ('Encrypt'). Keep the ' + ' pattern short: it sits in a narrow column.

actions_history_open_entry.description: aria-label of a history row button. $title$ is the row's title (recipient list, filename, or operation name).

actions_history_recipient_with_id.description: One recipient in the history entry's 'To' line: display name followed by the 8-character short key id in parentheses.

actions_history_search_label.description: aria-label of the history search box.

actions_history_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box at the top of the history page.

actions_history_to.description: History row title and entry detail line for an encrypt operation. $names$ is a comma-separated list of recipient names (or short key ids).

actions_history_truncated.description: Marker appended on its own line at the end of a stored history content that was cut short. Keep the square brackets.

actions_history_usage.description: Tiny storage usage line at the bottom of the history page. $used$ and $budget$ are formatted byte sizes like '12 KB'.

actions_history_when.description: History entry timestamp: $date$ is a full localised date-time, $relative$ is a relative phrase like '2 hours ago'.

actions_import_key.description: Command palette: open the key import page.

actions_keys_count_one.description: Recipient option sub-line: how many keys a contact holds (always more than one when shown).

actions_keys_count_other.description: Recipient option sub-line: how many keys a contact holds.

actions_keys_of_total.description: Recipient option sub-line for a contact holding several keys, some of which the user turned off. $active$ = keys that will be used, $count$ = keys the contact holds.

actions_language_last_used.description: Language option in the translate picker for the language most recently translated into. $label$ is the language name.

actions_lock_now.description: Command palette: lock the extension immediately.

actions_mixed_engine_reason.message: PGP and SSH recipients can't be combined in one message: OpenPGP and age are different formats. Encrypt to one group, then the other.
actions_mixed_engine_reason.description: Why a recipient of the other kind is dimmed in the picker, and the error when encrypt is attempted with a mixed selection. 'OpenPGP', 'PGP', 'SSH' and 'age' are format/tool names: keep them.

actions_need_recipient_or_password.message: Select at least one recipient, or set a password
actions_need_recipient_or_password.description: Disabled reason of the Run command in encrypt mode when nobody could open the result.

actions_no_input_decrypt.message: Nothing to decrypt - paste an encrypted message or drop a file
actions_no_input_decrypt.description: Disabled reason of the Run command in decrypt mode when the workspace has no input.

actions_no_input_encrypt.message: Nothing to encrypt - add text or drop a file
actions_no_input_encrypt.description: Disabled reason of the Run command in encrypt mode when the workspace has no input.

actions_no_input_sign.message: Nothing to sign - add text or drop a file
actions_no_input_sign.description: Disabled reason of the Run command in sign mode when the workspace has no input.

actions_no_input_verify.message: Nothing to verify - paste a signed message or drop a file
actions_no_input_verify.description: Disabled reason of the Run command in verify mode when the workspace has no input.

actions_no_keys_available.description: Default empty text of the key selector and recipient picker when there is no key to choose from.

actions_no_keys_found.description: Key selector dropdown empty state when the search filters out every key.

actions_no_matches.description: Recipient dropdown empty state when the search filters out every key.

actions_no_output_to_copy.description: Disabled reason of 'Copy output' before an operation has produced text.

actions_nothing_to_clear.description: Disabled reason of 'Clear input' when the workspace is already empty.

actions_nothing_to_download.description: Disabled reason of 'Download output' before an operation has produced a result.

actions_nothing_to_translate.description: Disabled reason of 'Translate message...' when the message box is empty.

actions_open_history.description: Command palette: open the history page.

actions_open_security_presets.description: Command palette: open the security presets page in Settings.

actions_palette_label.description: aria-label of the command palette dialog (opened with Ctrl/Cmd+K).

actions_palette_no_commands.description: Command palette when the query matches no command.

actions_palette_no_match.description: Command palette second step (e.g. language list) when the query matches no option.

actions_palette_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the command palette search box.

actions_pick_language_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box in the command palette's language list.

actions_recipient_input_hint.description: Tooltip of the recipient picker's inline input. 'Backspace' is the keyboard key.

actions_remove_recipient.description: aria-label and tooltip of a selected-recipient chip; clicking the chip removes it. $name$ is the recipient's display name.

actions_remove_recipient_detail.description: Tooltip of a selected-recipient chip when the key has a detail (email or comment). $name$ is the display name, $detail$ the email/comment.

actions_reply_to_signer.description: Command palette entry, shown while a decrypted message from a verified signer is on screen. Opens an encrypted reply to them in a new tab.

actions_run_mode.description: Command palette name of the Run command. $mode$ is the current mode name (Encrypt, Decrypt, Sign, Verify).

actions_save_to_history_off.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Save to history' preference is on.

actions_save_to_history_on.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Save to history' preference is off. Must match the workspace checkbox label.

actions_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the search box inside the key selector dropdown.

actions_select_key_placeholder.description: Key selector button text while no key is selected.

actions_set_up.description: Default label of the inline link shown after the 'No keys available' text, which opens key setup. Very short.

actions_sign_when_encrypting_off.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Sign when encrypting' preference is on.

actions_sign_when_encrypting_on.description: Command palette toggle, shown while the 'Sign when encrypting' preference is off. Must match the workspace checkbox label.

actions_ssh_password_reason.message: A message password is an OpenPGP feature and age has none, so SSH recipients can't be used with one. Remove the password, or encrypt to this person without it.
actions_ssh_password_reason.description: Why SSH recipients are dimmed in the picker once a message password is set, and the error when encrypt is attempted anyway. 'OpenPGP', 'SSH' and 'age' are format/tool names: keep them.

actions_style_bold.description: Command palette: make the selected message text bold.

actions_style_code.description: Command palette: format the selected message text as code (monospace).

actions_style_italic.description: Command palette: make the selected message text italic.

actions_style_strike.description: Command palette: strike through the selected message text.

actions_switch_to_workspace_first.description: Disabled reason of workspace commands while another tab is showing. 'Workspace' is the tab name.

actions_toggle_recipient_list.description: aria-label of the chevron button that opens/closes the recipient dropdown.

actions_translate_message.description: Command palette: translate the message being written; opens a language list as a second step.

actions_translate_result_to.description: Command palette: translate the decrypted/verified result into the user's reading language. $language$ is the language name.

actions_translate_to_title.description: Heading of the language list in the command palette's translate step.

actions_translation_off.description: Disabled reason of the translate commands when the translation feature is turned off. 'Settings' is the tab name.

app_action_title.description: Manifest: tooltip on the toolbar icon (action.default_title). Brand name, keep as 'PGP Tools' in every locale.

app_cmd_open.description: Manifest: description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the side panel, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_cmd_open_decrypt.message: Open PGP Tools in Decrypt mode
app_cmd_open_decrypt.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Decrypt mode.

app_cmd_open_encrypt.message: Open PGP Tools in Encrypt mode
app_cmd_open_encrypt.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Encrypt mode.

app_cmd_open_sign.message: Open PGP Tools in Sign mode
app_cmd_open_sign.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Sign mode.

app_cmd_open_verify.message: Open PGP Tools in Verify mode
app_cmd_open_verify.description: Manifest: keyboard shortcut description, shown at chrome://extensions/shortcuts. Opens the panel switched to the Verify mode.

app_copied.description: Success toast after copying to the clipboard. $label$ names what was copied, e.g. 'Public key', 'Fingerprint'.

app_copied_wipe.description: Success toast after copying sensitive material (a private key, a revocation certificate). $label$ names what was copied; $seconds$ is the number of seconds until the clipboard is wiped, followed by the seconds abbreviation.

app_copy_failed.message: Copy failed - click the extension panel first, then try again.
app_copy_failed.description: Error toast when writing to the clipboard fails because the side panel is not the focused window.

app_error_corrupted.message: The data is corrupted or was cut off. Get a fresh, complete copy and try again.
app_error_corrupted.description: User-facing error: the PGP data is malformed or truncated.

app_error_crx_unsigned.message: The CRX signature doesn't match: it wasn't signed by this key, or the file was modified after signing. Get a fresh copy from the publisher.
app_error_crx_unsigned.description: User-facing error: a Chrome extension package (CRX) failed signature verification against the chosen key.

app_error_key_expired.message: A key involved in this operation has expired. Ask the key's owner for an updated key, then import it.
app_error_key_expired.description: User-facing error: a recipient or signer key has passed its expiry date.

app_error_key_locked.message: This key is locked. Unlock it and try again.
app_error_key_locked.description: User-facing error: the private key needed is still locked.

app_error_key_not_found.message: That key is no longer in your keyring, so nothing was saved. Re-import the key and try again.
app_error_key_not_found.description: User-facing error: an operation referenced a key that has since been deleted from the keyring.

app_error_key_revoked.message: A key involved in this operation has been revoked by its owner. Get their replacement key, then import it.
app_error_key_revoked.description: User-facing error: a recipient or signer key carries a revocation.

app_error_no_decryption_key.message: This message is encrypted to a key you don't hold. Import that private key, or ask the sender to encrypt to one of your keys.
app_error_no_decryption_key.description: User-facing error: none of the user's private keys can decrypt this message (the recipient key ID is unknown).

app_error_no_decryption_key_with_id.message: This message is encrypted to a key you don't hold (key ID $key_id$). Import that private key, or ask the sender to encrypt to one of your keys.
app_error_no_decryption_key_with_id.description: User-facing error: none of the user's private keys can decrypt this message. $key_id$ is the hexadecimal ID of the key it was encrypted to.

app_error_not_crx.message: This isn't a Chrome extension package this tool can verify. Choose a CRX3 (.crx) file.
app_error_not_crx.description: User-facing error: the file given for CRX verification is not a Chrome extension package. 'CRX3' and '.crx' are technical names.

app_error_not_pgp_data.message: This doesn't look like PGP data. Make sure you pasted the full armored block, including the BEGIN and END lines.
app_error_not_pgp_data.description: User-facing error: the input could not be parsed as PGP at all. 'BEGIN' and 'END' refer to the literal armor header lines.

app_error_ocb_unsupported.message: This message uses an older AEAD (OCB) format this app can't read. Ask the sender to re-send it encrypted normally - any password they choose will work, it's the format that isn't supported.
app_error_ocb_unsupported.description: User-facing error: the message uses GnuPG's pre-standard AEAD (OCB) packet format. 'AEAD (OCB)' is a technical name; keep it.

app_error_passkey_dismissed.message: The passkey prompt was dismissed. Run the operation again when you're ready.
app_error_passkey_dismissed.description: User-facing notice: the user cancelled the browser's passkey prompt. Not a failure.

app_error_passkey_failed.message: Your passkey didn't complete. Try again, or unlock with a different method.
app_error_passkey_failed.description: User-facing error: the passkey (WebAuthn) ceremony failed.

app_error_password_required.message: This key needs its password. Enter the key password to unlock it.
app_error_password_required.description: User-facing error: a password-protected key was used without its password.

app_error_remedy_check_key.description: Button offered next to an expired/revoked key error; opens the recipient key so the user can check it.

app_error_remedy_import_key.description: Button offered next to an error whose fix is importing a key.

app_error_remedy_try_again.description: Button offered next to an error whose fix is retrying the operation.

app_error_storage_full.message: Browser storage is full, so this couldn't be saved. Remove keys or contacts you no longer need, then try again.
app_error_storage_full.description: User-facing error: the browser's extension storage quota is exhausted.

app_error_symmetric_wrong_password.message: That password didn't open this message. Check it and try again - if you're sure it's right, the message may be damaged.
app_error_symmetric_wrong_password.description: User-facing error: decrypting a password-encrypted (symmetric) message failed.

app_error_tampered.message: Signature verification failed - this message may have been tampered with. Don't trust the contents; ask the sender to re-send it.
app_error_tampered.description: User-facing error: the signature on a decrypted message did not verify.

app_error_vault_locked.message: Your vault is locked, so nothing was changed. Unlock it and run this again.
app_error_vault_locked.description: User-facing error: the encrypted vault (keys and contacts store) is locked so the write was refused.

app_error_weak_algorithm.message: This key uses a signature algorithm that is no longer considered secure. Ask the key's owner to reissue it with SHA-256 or stronger.
app_error_weak_algorithm.description: User-facing error: the key was rejected by the security policy (SHA-1 / MD5 signatures). 'SHA-256' is a technical name.

app_error_weak_password.message: That password is too short. Use at least 8 characters.
app_error_weak_password.description: User-facing error: a chosen password is under the minimum length. The 8 is fixed.

app_error_wrong_password.message: Wrong password for this key. Check it and try again.
app_error_wrong_password.description: User-facing error: the password entered does not unlock the key.

app_import_added_one.description: Success toast after importing keys from outside the Keys tab. $count$ is the number of keys imported (here 1; the English singular does not show the number).

app_import_added_other.description: Success toast after importing keys from outside the Keys tab. $count$ is the number of keys imported.

app_import_view_key_one.description: Action button on the key-added toast; jumps to the Keys tab and highlights the imported key. $count$ is the number of keys (1 here).

app_import_view_key_other.description: Action button on the keys-added toast; jumps to the Keys tab and highlights the imported keys. $count$ is the number of keys.

app_menu_open_in_pgp_tools.description: Right-click context menu item shown when text is selected on a web page. Sends the selection to the side panel. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_nav_label.description: aria-label of the side panel's top tab bar (screen readers only).

app_onboarding_advanced_options.description: Onboarding, key creation step: small toggle that reveals the algorithm and expiry choices.

app_onboarding_algo_ecc_hint.message: Modern, fast, small keys. Recommended for most uses.
app_onboarding_algo_ecc_hint.description: Onboarding, advanced options: tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when ECC is selected.

app_onboarding_algo_rsa_hint.description: Onboarding, advanced options: tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when RSA is selected.

app_onboarding_algorithm_label.description: Onboarding, advanced options: label of the key algorithm dropdown (ECC / RSA).

app_onboarding_comment_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the optional PGP user ID comment field.

app_onboarding_comment_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: placeholder of the Comment field, suggesting what a comment might say.

app_onboarding_create_key.description: Onboarding, key creation step: primary full-width button that generates the key.

app_onboarding_create_passkey.description: Onboarding, protection step: submit button when the passkey method is selected.

app_onboarding_email_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the email field (followed by app_onboarding_optional in lighter text).

app_onboarding_email_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: example address used as the email field placeholder. Use an obviously fake example address.

app_onboarding_expiry_label.description: Onboarding, advanced options: label of the key expiry dropdown.

app_onboarding_expiry_never.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option: the key never expires.

app_onboarding_expiry_years_one.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option. $count$ is the number of years (1, 2 or 3).

app_onboarding_expiry_years_other.description: Onboarding, key expiry dropdown option. $count$ is the number of years (1, 2 or 3).

app_onboarding_generate_failed.description: Onboarding, key creation step: fallback error shown when generating the key fails for an unknown reason.

app_onboarding_generating.description: Onboarding, generating step: status text under a spinner while the key is being generated.

app_onboarding_identity_body.message: Create a keypair for encrypting, decrypting, and signing messages.
app_onboarding_identity_body.description: Onboarding, key creation step: paragraph under the heading.

app_onboarding_intro_body.message: Send private messages that only the right person can read, and verify messages really came from who they claim.
app_onboarding_intro_body.description: Onboarding, first screen: one-sentence pitch under the 'PGP Tools' heading.

app_onboarding_keep_defaults.description: Onboarding, final step: secondary button that finishes onboarding without applying a preset.

app_onboarding_name_label.description: Onboarding, key creation step: label of the required Name field. The asterisk marks it as required; keep it.

app_onboarding_name_placeholder.description: Onboarding, key creation step: placeholder of the Name field.

app_onboarding_name_required.description: Onboarding, key creation step: validation error when the Name field is empty.

app_onboarding_next.description: Onboarding: full-width button that goes to the next step.

app_onboarding_optional.description: Onboarding, key creation step: lowercase word shown after a field label (Email, Comment) to mark the field as optional.

app_onboarding_passkey_prompt.description: Onboarding, generating step: status text under a spinner while the browser shows its passkey dialog.

app_onboarding_preset_body.message: How careful should PGP Tools be with your keys? Each option shows exactly what it sets, and you can change any of it later in Settings.
app_onboarding_preset_body.description: Onboarding, final step: paragraph under the heading. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name; 'Settings' is the settings tab.

app_onboarding_preset_title.description: Onboarding, final step heading: choose a bundle of security settings.

app_onboarding_prf_unsupported.message: Your authenticator does not support PRF. Try a different passkey or use a password instead.
app_onboarding_prf_unsupported.description: Onboarding, protection step: error shown when the passkey the user created cannot derive an encryption key (WebAuthn PRF extension). 'PRF' is a technical name; keep it.

app_onboarding_protection_body.message: Choose how to protect your contacts and keys. You will use this each time you open PGP Tools.
app_onboarding_protection_body.description: Onboarding, protection step: paragraph under the heading. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_onboarding_protection_title.description: Onboarding, protection step heading (choose a password or a passkey).

app_onboarding_rsa_slow.message: RSA keys take a moment to generate
app_onboarding_rsa_slow.description: Onboarding, generating step: small note under the spinner shown only when RSA was chosen.

app_onboarding_set_password.description: Onboarding, protection step: submit button when the password method is selected.

app_onboarding_setup_failed.description: Onboarding, protection step: fallback error shown when setting up the vault protection fails for an unknown reason.

app_onboarding_skip.description: Onboarding, key creation step: secondary button that skips creating a key for now.

app_onboarding_storage_question.message: Where should we store your data?
app_onboarding_storage_question.description: Onboarding, first screen: heading above the storage location picker (this device vs. synced).

app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault.description: Onboarding, final step: checkbox label (passkey users only). Opening the vault with the passkey also unlocks every key.

app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault_hint.message: The passkey prompt that opens the vault also unlocks your keys. No separate prompt per key. You can change this in Settings.
app_onboarding_unlock_with_vault_hint.description: Onboarding, final step: small explanation under the 'Unlock keys with the vault' checkbox.

app_onboarding_use_preset.description: Onboarding, final step: primary button that applies the selected security preset and finishes onboarding.

app_oversized_files_one.message: $files$: file is larger than $limit$ and can't be processed in the panel.
app_oversized_files_one.description: Error shown when a dropped file exceeds the size ceiling. $files$ is the file name; $limit$ is the ceiling, e.g. '4 GB'; $count$ is the number of oversized files (1 here).

app_oversized_files_other.message: $files$: files are larger than $limit$ and can't be processed in the panel.
app_oversized_files_other.description: Error shown when several dropped files exceed the size ceiling. $files$ is the list of file names (comma separated, or app_oversized_more); $limit$ is the ceiling, e.g. '4 GB'; $count$ is the number of oversized files.

app_oversized_more.description: Part of app_oversized_files: when more than three files were too large, the first three names ($names$, already comma separated) followed by how many others ($count$).

app_tab_main.description: Label of the first tab in the side panel's top tab bar (the workspace where encrypt/decrypt happens). Short: shares a narrow bar with the Keys tab.

app_vault_lock_retry.description: Button under the vault-unreadable error. Locks the vault so the user can unlock again.

app_vault_unreadable_body.message: Your keys are still stored on this device. Locking and trying again is the first thing to try.
app_vault_unreadable_body.description: Body text under app_vault_unreadable_title when the vault is protected by a password.

app_vault_unreadable_body_passkey.message: Your keys are still stored on this device. Locking and trying again is the first thing to try -- make sure you use the same passkey you set up.
app_vault_unreadable_body_passkey.description: Body text under app_vault_unreadable_title when the vault is protected by a passkey. Same as app_vault_unreadable_body plus the passkey reminder; keep the double hyphen as a dash.

app_vault_unreadable_title.message: Your vault could not be read.
app_vault_unreadable_title.description: Full-screen error shown after unlock when the stored keys cannot be decrypted. Heading line.

app_welcome_body.message: Click below to open the side panel and finish setting up your keys. After this, use the PGP Tools icon in the toolbar to re-open it any time.
app_welcome_body.description: Welcome page paragraph under the heading, above the start button. 'PGP Tools' is the brand name.

app_welcome_credit_after.description: Welcome page footer, punctuation right after the linked brand name 'Am I Being Pwned' (no leading space). Use the locale's sentence terminator or leave empty if none is wanted.

app_welcome_credit_before.description: Welcome page footer, text before the linked brand name 'Am I Being Pwned'. Rendered as: '<before> <link><after>' and the link text is not translated.

import_default_ssh_name.description: Fallback name stored for an imported SSH private key that carries no comment.

import_dropzone_text.message: Drop, paste, or browse for public keys
import_dropzone_text.description: Caption of the small contacts drop zone at the bottom of the keys list.

import_enter_passphrase.description: Error on the protect step when the source key is passphrase-protected and the passphrase field is empty.

import_failed.description: Fallback error text on the import panel when an import throws with no message of its own.

import_flagged_toast_one.message: $count$ key uses weak crypto (SHA-1) and was flagged - see the warning on the contact.
import_flagged_toast_one.description: Warning toast after importing contacts, when $count$ of them carry a security warning. SHA-1 is an algorithm name.

import_flagged_toast_other.message: $count$ keys use weak crypto (SHA-1) and were flagged - see the warning on the contact.
import_flagged_toast_other.description: Warning toast after importing contacts, when $count$ of them carry a security warning. SHA-1 is an algorithm name.

import_github_fetched_note.message: Fetched from github.com/$user$.keys. Messages are encrypted to every key listed above, so any one of their machines can read them.
import_github_fetched_note.description: Note on the import preview for keys fetched from GitHub. $user$ is the GitHub username; 'github.com/$user$.keys' is a URL and stays as is.

import_github_invalid_username.message: That isn't a GitHub username. Use the account name from the profile URL, e.g. “octocat” for github.com/octocat.
import_github_invalid_username.description: Lookup error when the background worker rejects the username. Keep the example as is.

import_github_no_keys.message: $username$ hasn't published any SSH keys on GitHub. Ask them to add one at github.com/settings/keys, or paste their key here instead.
import_github_no_keys.description: Amber notice (not an error) when the GitHub account exists but publishes no SSH keys. $username$ is the account name; github.com/settings/keys is a URL.

import_github_none_usable.message: None of the published keys can be used for encryption.
import_github_none_usable.description: Rejection reason when every key a GitHub account publishes was refused for differing reasons.

import_github_not_found.message: There's no GitHub account called “$username$”. Check the spelling - the name in the profile URL is the one to use.
import_github_not_found.description: Lookup error when GitHub has no such account. $username$ is what the user typed.

import_github_offline.message: Couldn't reach github.com. Check your connection and try again.
import_github_offline.description: Lookup error when github.com could not be reached.

import_github_omitted_line_one.description: Shown in place of a key line on the preview when the fetch cap held back $count$ of the account's keys.

import_github_omitted_line_other.description: Shown in place of a key line on the preview when the fetch cap held back $count$ of the account's keys.

import_github_omitted_reason.message: This import takes at most $max$ keys per account, and skips any single key that is implausibly long. $count$ of $username$'s published keys weren't fetched - paste one here if you need it.
import_github_omitted_reason.description: Reason under the '+N more published keys' line. $max$ is the per-account cap (a number), $count$ how many were skipped, $username$ the GitHub account name.

import_github_rate_limited.message: GitHub is rate-limiting this network. The limit is counted per IP address, so it can be used up by other people on the same connection.
import_github_rate_limited.description: Lookup error when GitHub returned a rate-limit response. A 'Try again in ...' sentence may follow it.

import_github_rejected_heading_one.description: Amber heading on the import preview above the list of fetched GitHub keys the engine refused.

import_github_rejected_heading_other.description: Amber heading on the import preview above the list of fetched GitHub keys the engine refused.

import_github_server_error.message: GitHub couldn't answer just now. Try again in a moment.
import_github_server_error.description: Lookup error when GitHub returned a server error.

import_group_help_one.message: These keys don't agree on a name, so they're imported as $count$ separate contact. Name them here to keep them together as one person - messages are then encrypted to all $count$ keys, and any one of their machines can read them.
import_group_help_one.description: Help text under the 'Group as one contact' field. $count$ is how many keys were pasted (always 2 or more in practice).

import_group_help_other.message: These keys don't agree on a name, so they're imported as $count$ separate contacts. Name them here to keep them together as one person - messages are then encrypted to all $count$ keys, and any one of their machines can read them.
import_group_help_other.description: Help text under the 'Group as one contact' field. $count$ is how many keys were pasted.

import_group_keys_chip_one.description: Chip in the import preview saying how many keys a multi-key contact holds.

import_group_keys_chip_other.description: Chip in the import preview saying how many keys a multi-key contact holds.

import_group_keys_chip_title.message: Messages are encrypted to all of them; any one can decrypt
import_group_keys_chip_title.description: Tooltip on the key-count chip of a multi-key contact in the import preview.

import_group_label.description: Field label on the import preview asking for a name to file several pasted SSH keys under as one contact.

import_group_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the 'Group as one contact' field.

import_group_proposal_label_one.description: Headline of the preview for several pasted SSH keys the user has not named yet. $count$ is how many.

import_group_proposal_label_other.description: Headline of the preview for several pasted SSH keys the user has not named yet. $count$ is how many.

import_importing.description: Preview primary button text while the import is running.

import_keyserver_invalid_query.message: That isn't an email address or a key fingerprint. Use the address the key is published under, or paste the full 40-character fingerprint.
import_keyserver_invalid_query.description: Lookup error when the background worker rejects the keyserver query.

import_keyserver_multiple_keys.message: $host$ returned more than one key for this lookup. Only the first is shown - check the fingerprint before importing it.
import_keyserver_multiple_keys.description: Warning toast after a keyserver lookup that returned several keys. $host$ is the keyserver hostname (keys.openpgp.org).

import_keyserver_not_a_key.message: $host$ answered, but what it sent isn't a key we can read.
import_keyserver_not_a_key.description: Error after a keyserver lookup whose response was not a parseable certificate. $host$ is the keyserver hostname (keys.openpgp.org).

import_keyserver_not_found_email.message: $host$ has no key for $subject$. It only publishes an address once the key's owner has confirmed it, so they may have a key there that this lookup can't find - ask them for it directly, or look it up by fingerprint.
import_keyserver_not_found_email.description: Amber notice (not an error) when the keyserver has no key for an email address. $host$ is the keyserver hostname (keys.openpgp.org), $subject$ the address typed.

import_keyserver_not_found_fingerprint.message: $host$ has no key with the fingerprint $subject$. Check it against the one you were given - a single wrong character is enough.
import_keyserver_not_found_fingerprint.description: Amber notice (not an error) when the keyserver has no key for a fingerprint. $host$ is the keyserver hostname, $subject$ the fingerprint in groups of four.

import_keyserver_offline.message: Couldn't reach $host$. Check your connection and try again.
import_keyserver_offline.description: Lookup error when the keyserver could not be reached. $host$ is the keyserver hostname (keys.openpgp.org).

import_keyserver_rate_limited.description: Lookup error when the keyserver returned a rate-limit response. $host$ is the keyserver hostname. A 'Try again in ...' sentence may follow it.

import_keyserver_server_error.message: $host$ couldn't answer just now. Try again in a moment.
import_keyserver_server_error.description: Lookup error when the keyserver returned a server error. $host$ is the keyserver hostname.

import_label_field.description: Field label on the protect step for naming an imported Chrome extension signing key.

import_label_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the Label field for a Chrome extension signing key.

import_lookup_button.description: Button next to the lookup field that runs the GitHub / keyserver lookup. Short.

import_lookup_failed.description: Fallback error text when a GitHub / keyserver lookup throws with no message of its own.

import_lookup_invalid.message: That isn't a GitHub username, an email address or a key fingerprint. Try “octocat”, “alice@example.com”, or the full 40-character fingerprint.
import_lookup_invalid.description: Error under the lookup field when the typed text is neither a GitHub username, an email address nor a fingerprint. Keep the example values as they are.

import_lookup_label.description: Label above the lookup field (GitHub username / email / fingerprint) on the import source step.

import_lookup_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the lookup field on the import source step.

import_n_contacts_one.description: Preview primary button when pasted SSH keys are imported separately; $count$ is how many contacts result. Button width.

import_n_contacts_other.description: Preview primary button when pasted SSH keys are imported separately; $count$ is how many contacts result. Button width.

import_no_key.description: Error on the protect step when the import is submitted but no key material is held.

import_optional.description: Lower-case suffix after a field label meaning the field may be left blank ("Label optional", "Group as one contact optional").

import_panel_aria_with_id.description: aria-label of the standalone preview panel (dev harness). $keyid$ is a key fingerprint, not translated.

import_passphrase_label.message: This key is protected with a passphrase
import_passphrase_label.description: Label above the passphrase field on the protect step, shown when the source key is encrypted.

import_passphrase_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the passphrase field on the protect step.

import_paste_hint.message: Paste the whole key block - a key is too long to type out.
import_paste_hint.description: Hint shown under the paste box when the user starts typing into it instead of pasting.

import_paste_label.description: aria-label of the one-line paste target box on the import source step.

import_paste_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the paste target box. $shortcut$ is the keyboard shortcut ("⌘V" or "Ctrl+V"), not translated.

import_private_unreadable.message: Could not read that private key.
import_private_unreadable.description: Error on the import source step when a private key was detected but its secret half could not be extracted.

import_reading.description: Status text in the drop zone while pasted or dropped text is being parsed.

import_reject_expired.message: This key expired on $date$. Ask the owner for their current key.
import_reject_expired.description: Reason a public key cannot be imported as a contact. $date$ is a localised long date.

import_reject_no_public_key.message: This block contains no usable public key.
import_reject_no_public_key.description: Reason a pasted armored block cannot be imported as a contact: it parsed to no certificate.

import_reject_ssh_generic.message: This SSH key can't be used for encryption.
import_reject_ssh_generic.description: Fallback reason when the SSH engine refuses a key without giving a message.

import_reject_unusable.message: This public key has no usable encryption or signing key.
import_reject_unusable.description: Reason a public key cannot be imported as a contact: no live subkey for either purpose.

import_rejected_generic.description: Fallback reason above the preview footer when a key is rejected and no specific reason is known.

import_retry_hours_one.description: Appended to a rate-limit error; $count$ is hours until the limit lifts.

import_retry_hours_other.description: Appended to a rate-limit error; $count$ is hours until the limit lifts.

import_retry_minute.description: Appended to a rate-limit error when the limit lifts within a minute.

import_retry_minutes_one.description: Appended to a rate-limit error; $count$ is minutes until the limit lifts (2 to 59 in practice).

import_retry_minutes_other.description: Appended to a rate-limit error; $count$ is minutes until the limit lifts (2 to 59 in practice).

import_reveal.description: Preview button for a key that is already stored: closes the panel and highlights the key in the list.

import_source_help.message: Public keys are added as contacts. A private key stays on this device - you'll choose how it's protected next.
import_source_help.description: Muted help text at the bottom of the import source step.

import_ssh_headline.description: Headline name shown in the preview for an SSH public key line that carries no comment.

import_ssh_private_headline.description: Headline name shown in the preview for an OpenSSH private key before it is imported.

import_ssh_private_note.description: Explanatory note on the import preview for an OpenSSH private key. 'age' is the name of an encryption tool, not translated.

import_status_added_on.description: Line under the 'Updates the key you already have' heading. $date$ is a localised long date.

import_status_duplicate.description: Green strip heading on the preview when the key is already stored and unchanged.

import_status_duplicate_added.message: You added it on $date$, and nothing about it has changed.
import_status_duplicate_added.description: Line under the 'Already in your keys' heading. $date$ is a localised long date.

import_status_update.message: Updates the key you already have
import_status_update.description: Blue strip heading on the preview when the key updates a stored one.

import_submit.description: Submit button of the protect step. Short, button width.

import_title.description: Import slide-over panel header title and aria-label, shown while a key is being pasted or previewed for the first time.

import_title_update.description: Import slide-over panel header title when the previewed key updates one that is already stored.

import_unknown_name.description: Headline of the import preview when the key carries no user ID at all.

import_unreadable.message: That doesn't look like a key we can read. Paste an armored PGP key block or an SSH public key line, or browse for a key file.
import_unreadable.description: Error under the import source step when the pasted/dropped text parses as no key at all.

import_updated_contacts_one.description: Info toast after a bulk import; $count$ is how many existing contacts were refreshed.

import_updated_contacts_other.description: Info toast after a bulk import; $count$ is how many existing contacts were refreshed.

import_worker_unreachable.message: Couldn't reach the extension's background worker.
import_worker_unreachable.description: Error on the import source step when a lookup request to the extension's background service worker gets no reply.

keygen_advanced_options.description: Toggle that reveals algorithm, key size and expiry settings.

keygen_algorithm_hint_ecc.message: Modern, fast, small keys. Recommended for most uses.
keygen_algorithm_hint_ecc.description: Tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when ECC (Ed25519) is selected.

keygen_algorithm_hint_rsa.description: Tiny hint under the algorithm dropdown when RSA is selected.

keygen_algorithm_label.description: Field label above the key algorithm dropdown (ECC / RSA).

keygen_comment_label.description: Field label for the optional OpenPGP user ID comment.

keygen_comment_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the comment field; example comments.

keygen_confirm_passphrase_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the repeat-passphrase field on export.

keygen_confirm_password.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the repeat-password field.

keygen_copied_encrypted.description: Green feedback after copying a passphrase-encrypted private key to the clipboard; the clipboard is wiped after 60 seconds.

keygen_copied_plaintext.description: Green feedback after copying an unencrypted private key to the clipboard; the clipboard is wiped after 30 seconds.

keygen_create_heading.description: Big heading on the first (identity) step of key generation.

keygen_create_subtitle_crx.message: A new RSA-2048 signing key for packaging a Chrome extension (.crx).
keygen_create_subtitle_crx.description: Subtitle under the heading when the CRX (Chrome extension signing) key type is selected. RSA-2048 and .crx stay as is.

keygen_create_subtitle_pgp.message: A new OpenPGP keypair for encrypting, decrypting, and signing messages.
keygen_create_subtitle_pgp.description: Subtitle under the heading when the PGP (messaging) key type is selected.

keygen_email_label.description: Field label for the optional email address in the key's user ID.

keygen_email_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the email field; an example address.

keygen_encrypting.description: Copy/export button text while the private key is being encrypted under the passphrase.

keygen_error_expiry_past.message: Expiry date must be in the future.
keygen_error_expiry_past.description: Validation error on the custom expiry step when the picked date is not after today.

keygen_error_expiry_required.description: Validation error on the custom expiry step when no calendar date is picked.

keygen_error_generation_failed.description: Fallback error shown on the protection step when key generation throws without a message.

keygen_error_key_not_unlocked.description: Error on the export private key page when the key's session handle has gone (key re-locked).

keygen_error_name_required.description: Validation error on the identity step when the name field is empty.

keygen_error_passkey_failed.description: Error under a key's unlock control when the passkey ceremony fails (not when the user cancels).

keygen_error_passphrase_mismatch.description: Validation error when the two export passphrase fields differ.

keygen_error_passphrase_short.message: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.
keygen_error_passphrase_short.description: Validation error when the export passphrase is under 8 characters.

keygen_error_password_mismatch.description: Validation error when the two password fields differ.

keygen_error_password_short.message: Password must be at least 8 characters.
keygen_error_password_short.description: Validation error when the new key password is under 8 characters.

keygen_error_prf_unsupported_authenticat.message: Your authenticator doesn't support PRF. Try a different passkey or use a password instead.
keygen_error_prf_unsupported_authenticat.description: Error shown on the protection step when the passkey just registered cannot derive a key (no WebAuthn PRF). 'PRF' is a technical name; keep.

keygen_error_wrong_password.description: Error under a key's unlock field when the entered password does not open it.

keygen_expires_on.description: Line under the calendar once a date is picked. $date$ is a localised long date.

keygen_expiry_1y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires one year from now.

keygen_expiry_2y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires two years from now (the default).

keygen_expiry_3y.description: Expiry dropdown option: expires three years from now.

keygen_expiry_custom.description: Expiry dropdown option: pick a specific date on a calendar.

keygen_expiry_heading.description: Big heading on the custom expiry calendar step.

keygen_expiry_label.description: Field label above the key expiry dropdown.

keygen_expiry_never.description: Expiry dropdown option: the key never expires.

keygen_expiry_subtitle.message: After this date the key can no longer be used; you can always generate a new one.
keygen_expiry_subtitle.description: Subtitle under the expiry heading explaining what expiry means.

keygen_export.description: Primary button on the export step when only public keys (contacts) are being exported, so no passphrase is needed.

keygen_export_contacts_included_one.message: $count$ contact will also be included (public keys, no unlock needed).
keygen_export_contacts_included_one.description: Note on the unlock step of bulk export. $count$ is the number of contacts whose public keys go in the file.

keygen_export_contacts_included_other.message: $count$ contacts will also be included (public keys, no unlock needed).
keygen_export_contacts_included_other.description: Note on the unlock step of bulk export. $count$ is the number of contacts whose public keys go in the file.

keygen_export_crx_included_one.message: Plus $count$ CRX signing key, re-encrypted under this passphrase so they restore on any device.
keygen_export_crx_included_one.description: Export step note when CRX (Chrome extension) signing keys are unlocked. $count$ is how many.

keygen_export_crx_included_other.message: Plus $count$ CRX signing keys, re-encrypted under this passphrase so they restore on any device.
keygen_export_crx_included_other.description: Export step note when CRX (Chrome extension) signing keys are unlocked. $count$ is how many.

keygen_export_failed_detail.description: Error when building the export bundle throws. $message$ is the underlying error text (may be English).

keygen_export_nothing.description: Muted line on the export step when there are no unlocked keys and no contacts.

keygen_export_passphrase_intro.description: Muted explanation above the passphrase fields on the export step. 'OpenPGP S2K' and 'GnuPG' are technical names; keep.

keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out.message: CRX signing keys are left out of a plaintext export -- use a passphrase to include them.
keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out.description: Extra sentence appended to the plaintext warning when CRX signing keys exist; they are never written unencrypted.

keygen_export_plaintext_warning_file.message: Plaintext export. Anyone who reads the downloaded file gets full control of every PGP key in it.
keygen_export_plaintext_warning_file.description: Red warning above the type-to-confirm field for an unencrypted bulk export. Followed by keygen_export_plaintext_crx_left_out (when CRX keys exist) and then the 'Type EXPORT to confirm:' fragments.

keygen_export_skip_locked.description: Button on the unlock step that proceeds to export without the still-locked keys.

keygen_export_still_locked_after.description: Punctuation directly after the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, closing that sentence. May be empty if your language needs no closing mark.

keygen_export_still_locked_one.message: $count$ key still locked and will be left out.
keygen_export_still_locked_one.description: Amber warning on the export step. $count$ is the number of keys left locked. Followed by a space, the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, then keygen_export_still_locked_after.

keygen_export_still_locked_other.message: $count$ keys still locked and will be left out.
keygen_export_still_locked_other.description: Amber warning on the export step. $count$ is the number of keys left locked. Followed by a space, the keygen_export_go_back_unlock link, then keygen_export_still_locked_after.

keygen_export_summary.message: Downloads one $ext$ file (standard ASCII-armored OpenPGP): your $private_keys$ as $private_block$s and your $contacts$ as $public_block$s.
keygen_export_summary.description: Export step summary. $ext$ is the literal '.asc'; $private_keys$ is keygen_export_summary_private_keys ('2 unlocked private keys'); $contacts$ is keygen_export_summary_contacts ('3 contacts'); $private_block$ / $public_block$ are the literal armor headers 'PGP PRIVATE KEY BLOCK' / 'PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK' (rendered monospace; the trailing 's' after each pluralises it in English, drop or rephrase as your language needs).

keygen_export_title.description: Default header title of the bulk key export page.

Use $save$ to write the $crx$ straight to disk with the right name (or drag the chip to your desktop), then upload it to the dashboard.
